title: Restrictions T⌞A exist and have locally finite mass (Simon 2.9)
statement:
Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open and T ∈ D_n(U).
(a) Let (μ, v) be a measure representation of T (IsMeasureRepresentation T μ v: for every ω ∈ Dⁿ(U), ⟨ω,v⟩ is μ-integrable and T(ω) = ∫⟨ω,v⟩ dμ), and let A ⊆ ℝ^P be Borel. Then there is S ∈ D_n(U) with IsRestriction T A S.
(b) If A ⊆ ℝ^P and S ∈ D_n(U) satisfy IsRestriction T A S, then M_W(S) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U (CompactlyContainedOpen W U).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsMeasureRepresentation T μ v → ∀ A : Set (Eucl P), MeasurableSet A → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn U n, IsRestriction T A S) ∧ ∀ (A : Set (Eucl P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsRestriction T A S → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), CompactlyContainedOpen W U → S.massOn W < ∞
